Guide.comment: ElevenLabs premade 'Rachel' - warm coach voice. Swap voice_id to taste.

AXIOM.comment: 'AGEIS-7' (shared voice, saved in My Voices as AXIOM_AGEIS7) - unsettling AI. Runners-up also in My Voices: AXIOM_Elon, AXIOM_Hakan, AXIOM_Yucel, AXIOM_Sigma, AXIOM_Systemus.

lines.text: Pawns only go forward! Click the glowing square to move.
On your first step, you can sprint two squares!
Pawns capture diagonally! Zigzag through all the enemies!
lines.match: Pawns capture DIAGONALLY! Zigzag through all the enemies!

lines.text: Race to the top! The enemy pawn is coming toward you. Dodge it, or capture it!
lines.match: BOSS: Race to the top! The enemy pawn is coming toward you — dodge or capture it!

lines.text: You captured the enemy pawn! You win the race!
You won the race! You've mastered the pawn!
The enemy pawn reached the end! Try again. You can do it!
lines.match: The enemy pawn reached the end! Try again — you can do it!

lines.text: You did it! Pawns march forward, one step at a time!
You captured and conquered! Diagonal captures are your secret weapon!
Rooks slide in straight lines! Slide across to grab the pieces!
lines.match: Rooks slide in straight lines! Slide across to grab the pieces!

lines.text: Up, down, left, right. As far as you want!
lines.match: Up, down, left, right — as far as you want!

lines.text: Rooks can't go through walls. Find another way!
lines.match: Rooks can't go through walls — find another way!

lines.text: You caught the runner! Straight lines, unstoppable!
The runner escaped! Try again. Trap it against the edge!
lines.match: The runner escaped! Try again — trap it against the edge!

lines.text: You found the way around! Nothing stops a clever rook!
Bishops only move diagonally! Stay on your color and grab the pieces!
lines.match: Bishops only move diagonally! Stay on your color and grab the pieces!

lines.text: Some pieces are on purple squares. I can't reach those, they're not my color!
lines.match: Some pieces are on purple squares — I can't reach those, they're not my color!

lines.text: A wall on your diagonal! Find another diagonal around it!
See? Bishops stay on one color forever. That's their secret!
You found another diagonal! Clever!
Knights move in an L. Two squares one way, one to the side! Hop to the stars!
lines.match: Knights move in an L — two squares one way, one to the side! Hop to the stars!

lines.text: You're walled in?! Not a problem. Knights jump over anything!
lines.match: You're walled in?! Not a problem — knights JUMP over anything!

lines.text: Follow the star trail! One L-hop at a time, like connect-the-dots!
lines.match: Follow the star trail! One L-hop at a time — like connect-the-dots!

lines.text: Tag! You got her! Nobody escapes a knight!
lines.match: TAG! You got her! Nobody escapes a knight!

lines.text: Luna got away! Try again. Cut off her escape routes!
lines.match: Luna got away! Try again — cut off her escape routes!

lines.text: See? Walls mean nothing to a knight!
lines.match: See? Walls mean NOTHING to a knight!

lines.text: Trail complete! You've mastered the L!
Move like Tara's rook! Slide straight and grab them all!
Now move like Zig's bishop! Slide diagonally!
Now use both! Straight and diagonal. You're unstoppable!
lines.match: Now use BOTH! Straight AND diagonal — you're unstoppable!

lines.text: Rows, columns, diagonals. The whole board is yours!
lines.match: Rows, columns, diagonals — the whole board is yours!

lines.text: You made it through without a single alarm. That's king discipline!
Alarm! Check! Back to safety!
lines.match: ALARM! CHECK! Back to safety!

lines.text: Check! The alarm rings. Next piece!
lines.match: CHECK! The alarm rings. Next piece!

lines.text: Now flip it: YOU give the check! Move your rook so its path hits AXIOM's king.
AXIOM blocks it. That's P, Protect!
AXIOM runs away. That's R, Run!
AXIOM has noticed you...
Five checks, and AXIOM escaped every single one.
Interesting. Remember this feeling, cadet.
No squares glow. Try clicking around. Is ANY square safe?
lines.match: ...no squares glow. Try clicking around. Is ANY square safe?

lines.text: Click your king first!
Hint: try the gold move! Click the gold rook, then the gold square.
lines.match: Hint: try the GOLD move! Click the gold rook, then the gold square.

lines.text: Click one of YOUR rooks first, then where it should go.
A rook only slides in straight lines. Pick a glowing square!
Click your piece first, then where it should go.
That square isn't reachable. Pick a glowing one!
You dodged the stalemate trap. AXIOM's firewall is next.
AXIOM is waiting in the core. Finish this.
lines.match: AXIOM is waiting in THE CORE. Finish this.

lines.text: That square isn't reachable! Look at the glowing squares.
Oops, no moves left! Let's try again. Remember: capture diagonally!
Amazing! You've mastered this piece!
Great job! Ready for the next challenge?
Your friends already hacked his army. His queen and a rook are gone!
Now finish it the only way that counts: checkmate.
Checkmate! AXIOM is defeated, and Neo City is free. You are a Chess Cadet! Thank you for playing!
So. The little cadet made it to my core.
My firewall has no weaknesses.
lines.match: AXIOM: "My firewall has no weaknesses."

lines.text: Alarms can't stop me!
...No safe squares?!
lines.match: AXIOM: "...no safe squares?!" Interesting. Remember this feeling, cadet.

lines.text: This time, YOU are the hunted king!
The rook has you in CHECK! The red squares show its reach.
Click your king, then click a safe square. RUN!
You escaped! When the king CAN get away, it's only CHECK.
The game goes on. But what if there were NOWHERE to run...
Can't go there. Keep trying, find ANY legal move...
That square is guarded! Try another...
Nothing works! But look: you're NOT in check.
No check plus no moves equals STALEMATE. Nobody wins. It's a draw.
lines.match: No check + no moves = STALEMATE. Nobody wins. It's a DRAW.

lines.text: Every square is guarded. There IS no escape.
Check plus no way out equals CHECKMATE. The game ends right there.
lines.match: Check + no way out = CHECKMATE. The game ends right there.

lines.text: That's how chess is won. Now YOU learn to build one.
The LADDER MATE! It's the first checkmate every cadet learns.
One rook guards a row like a wall. The other pushes the king up.
Walk him to the top edge! Click a rook, then click where it goes.
CHECKMATE! Attacked, and nowhere to go. LOCKDOWN!
The ladder mate: wall, push, wall, push. You built it yourself.
Whoa, STALEMATE! He's NOT in check, but he has no moves.
That's a DRAW, not a win. Always leave him a path... right into your trap.
Each board has ONE move that locks his king down. Find it!
Hey! Fellow player, welcome to the grid! Here you will learn the basics of how to use each of the chess pieces. Go ahead and give it a try!
Your king moves one square in any direction.
Grab the data tokens to power up the grid!
Enemies! RED shows every square they can attack.
If your king stands on red, they could capture him next turn. That's called CHECK.
Get the last token without stepping on red!
CHECK! That bishop is one move from taking your king!
In chess you must escape check RIGHT NOW. There are 3 ways: C, P, R.
lines.match: In chess you must escape check RIGHT NOW. There are 3 ways: C-P-R.

lines.text: C means CAPTURE. The bishop is close enough, take it!
lines.match: C = CAPTURE. The bishop is close enough, take it!

lines.text: CHECK! This rook attacks from across the board. Too far to capture!
P means PROTECT: block the path with another piece.
lines.match: P = PROTECT: block the path with another piece.

lines.text: Slide your rook between them, like a shield!
CHECK! Too far to capture, and nothing can block!
R means RUN: move your king to any square that isn't red.
lines.match: R = RUN: move your king to any square that isn't red.

lines.text: Now the bishop! Check the king on a diagonal.
Luna's turn! One L-hop to check the king.
The queen can check ANY way. Pick your path!
Even the pawn can check! Pawns hit diagonally. March up!
You can't capture a king. No one can! Threaten him, over and over.
The red squares are HIS reach. Leave your queen there and he'll capture her!
He knows C, P, R too...
lines.match: He knows C-P-R too...

lines.text: Keep chasing him!
CAPTURED! The attacker is gone, so the check is gone.
BLOCKED! Your rook stands in the attack's path.
See the red disappear behind it? Your king is safe.
Safe! That's all three escapes: Capture, Protect, Run.
Remember: in chess you can NEVER ignore check. Fix it first, always.
CHECK, five ways!
Every piece can do it.
No check yet...
Pick a square that can HIT the king!
That's the secret: check can always be answered with C, P, R.
lines.match: That's the secret: check can always be answered with C-P-R.

lines.text: CHECKMATE is a check with NO escape. That's how you win. LEVEL 7: THE FIREWALL!
He took your queen! That's C, Capture!
Don't stop on red squares.
Here's a new queen. Try again!
When YOU'RE winning, stalemate is a trap. Never leave him move-less without check!
Let's try again.
He grabbed your rook! It stood too close, with no one guarding it.
Keep the rooks far along their rows. The wall works from ANY distance.
One more secret. You're the black king again.
Here's the strange part: you are NOT in check right now.
It's your turn. Click your king and try to move ANYWHERE...
Now YOU have the queen. Don't fall for the trap you just felt!
One queen move is CHECKMATE. Another is that STALEMATE. Choose!
CHECKMATE! Attacked AND trapped. That's the winning move!
The firewall is DOWN!
You can spot mate, build mate, and dodge the stalemate trap.
STALEMATE! No check and no moves is only a draw.
lines.match: STALEMATE! No check and no moves is only a DRAW.

lines.text: So close! The winning move traps him IN check. Again!
He can still escape. That wasn't a lockdown.
Look for the move that leaves NO safe squares. Again!
